detail:
New decision "Chose to fix the v3 working-set renderer (observation body + revision range) BEFORE the trial and record the new SHA as the object under test, over measuring v3 as shipped" relates to:
- 01KQTRRN0CFQCAT0N3KSXRNXW8: "Chose two specs over one combined spec"
- 01KQV88TKHG29D06K6B40WV2CV: "Chose Vitest with child_process.spawnSync for hook tests over bats/shell-only"
- 01KQV88TMGHE6ENP9EP7W0Z1HY: "Chose to phase the work as: verifications first → test helper → server gate → simple hook guards → ensure-claude-md-gates (compound changes) → SessionStart command hook → versions → manual smoke test → release. Foundation-first ordering means each phase's tests can rely on infrastructure from prior phases."
- 01KQVA2PWT7HWDEVH04MNXDM8S: "Reconsidered SEARCH_PATHS marker-search order in ensure-claude-md-gates.sh. Original spec said global-first (cheapest,"
- 01KYXA3B5A7YYQDQEBVC70NVNP: "Chose to state the Gate 1 / Gate 2 enforcement asymmetry explicitly in the README rather than keep the simpler 'hooks enforce both automatically'"
- 01M08Y6N4FWH2B7V41KMTJTA1B: "Chose to add a first-class exact-match mode (mode: semantic|exact on search_decisions/twining_query) as a Wave 2 rider over leaving keyword search as fallback-only"
- 01M2KCVSP62A2P3NY4R01C1KSJ: "Chose to keep the baseline gap reproductions as characterization tests (green while the gap exists, red when a lane closes it) rather than converting them to xfail-style expectations"
- 01M2KF04PDF60DR8VF5K80GS5B: "Chose to prune the eight Stage 0 reproduction worktrees immediately after confirming their gap tests were already committed on foundation/v3"
- 01M2M1X6P0EYR9E3BQ1RGR3Q85: "Rebuilt every matrix count by running the suite against the merged tree rather than transcribing the lanes' self-reported numbers"
- 01M2M1X6Q6N1XQG9RP8FR9QP34: "Marked C07, C13 and C23 not-tested rather than partial, and recorded that C13's stated blocker (the Git carrier) has since merged so it is now a coverage gap rather than a dependency"
- 01M2P29B032QPDB0B947SPWZB1: "Prompts carry the reason-code list and decision words literally (frozen bytes = seen bytes) with exactly two run-time placeholders {{arm_pointer}} and {{ceiling_inline}}; build-specs asserts each prompt names every code, word, (qid), action, now and answer file"
summary: Related decisions in scope: 11 existing decision(s) overlap
